descriptionDraft: ACP Employee gives authorized employees secure access to their assigned work, job details, timeclock, time history, and other own-data capabilities provided by ACP Enterprise. Available screens and actions are determined by current Company, Branch, Employee, and permission authority.
betaDescription: Validate secure sign-in and session restoration, My Day, assigned Job details, authoritative Timeclock and My Time, offline/stale recovery, and logout against synthetic ACP Preview data.
reviewNotesDraft: ACP Employee has no public account creation. ACP supplies a bounded synthetic Preview employee review account separately through App Review's protected credential fields. The app shows only work and own-data authorized by ACP Enterprise. Directions are an explicit handoff to Apple Maps; the app does not track location. No payment collection or arbitrary customer messaging is present.
internalTesterInstructions: Confirm the installed build reports PREVIEW in Account before signing in.
Use only the sanctioned synthetic Preview employee identity.
Validate sign-in, session restoration, My Day, assigned Job, Timeclock, My Time, recovery, and logout.
Stop immediately if any Production endpoint or real customer/employee data appears.
employeeBetaInstructions: Install only the owner-approved TestFlight build.
Activate or sign in with your individually issued ACP credentials; never share a password.
Verify PREVIEW is shown during beta acceptance.
Report the app version/build and safe correlation reference with any issue; never send passwords or activation links.
ownerDecisionsRequired: live privacy-policy URL and legal approval
age rating, content rights, availability, and review contact
